data_preparation.aggregation: Per agent per calendar day; numeric transaction/cash-flow values are summed; liquidity_limit and location_id use first daily value.
data_preparation.history_features: Lag and rolling features use shifted historical cash-out values only.
data_preparation.target_rule: Next observed record is used only when target_date is exactly one calendar day after source date.
data_preparation.split: Chronological 70/15/15 split by unique target dates.

important_notes: liquidity_limit is treated as a capacity/limit proxy, not confirmed real-time available cash.
Risk bands are validation-quantile operational stress bands, not probabilities of shortage.
Recommended-cash coverage is not model accuracy.
The point forecast has weak R-squared on the synthetic test set; the prototype value is uncertainty-aware operational liquidity planning.
Outputs are decision support and require human/operator review before consequential financial action.
Dataset is synthetic and contains no real customer PII.
